variants.A0: Original max B7 then nonempty, calibrated scalar threshold; preserve exact428 baseline
variants.A1: Before max B7 require nonempty and R>=.95
variants.A2: Before max B7 require nonempty and R>=.95,C>=.95,S>=.95

calibration: validation mean retained Dice>=.95 and n>=20; maximum count, lower threshold ties; if infeasible maximize mean among n>=20
training_arm_selection: Among distinct A1/A2 calibrated pools, prefer validation quality target met, then validation count, mean Dice, then simpler A1; no train GT used
matched_coverage: Common K=min(428, available nonempty eligible targets of A0/A1/A2); top K by B7, then target_id; diagnostic only

training.weights: all GT/pseudo samples1; once/image/epoch; no GT oversampling
training.lora: image-model full-module LoRA rank16 alpha32 dropout.1
training.selection: best mean direct validation Dice over epochs0..10; tie keeps earlier
training.test: after both runs finish and both val-best checkpoints frozen, evaluate both direct test100; fixed text, class>=.5, mask>=.5, union
training.comparison_limit: same epochs means different update counts if pool sizes differ; evaluate practical pool recipe; matched-K is offline diagnostic

train_gt_audit: after all pools and training arm frozen only
